values.note: recreation.gov 2026 and 2027: $32 per family site; the group site $166. The Forest Service page (last updated June 2025) says $34 per night.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232158/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 32, RV NONELECTRIC 32, GROUP 166) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/bogan-flats-campground ('Single Site: $34 per night'; last updated June 6, 2025), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/bogan-flats-campground ('No hook ups. Water available from faucets') + campsite catalog for 232158 (all sites NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Forest Service: '40-foot maximum RV length'. The recreation.gov catalog lists 35 family sites (34 reservable, 1 first-come) with max vehicle lengths of 20-80 ft and seven pull-throughs, plus a group site 1/4 mile east.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/bogan-flats-campground ('This campground offers 35 campsites plus a host site'; '40-foot maximum RV length') + campsite catalog for 232158 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Two composting toilets and a vault toilet; water from faucets in the main campground (none at the group site). Nearest dump station Glenwood Springs.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/bogan-flats-campground ('Yes - composting toilets (2), Vault toilet (1)'; 'Potable water is available at this site. The main campground has water, but the group site does not.'; 'Dump Station - Glenwood Springs (35 miles northwest)') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232158 ('There is no dump station onsite'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov; the 2026 fee season is May 13 - Oct 1 (no first-come season is listed). One family site is first-come. Booking closes 2 days before arrival. No minimum stay (recreation.gov's minimums are 0). 14 nights at most, and 14 per month. Campers must occupy the site the first night.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232158 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Each Month', minWeekendStay 0 soft, minHolidayWeekendStay 0 soft, reservationCutOff 2 'day(s) prior to arrival'; notice 'Campers must occupy the site the first night') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 05-13 to 10-01) + campsite catalog (site 020 not reservable), read 2026-10-26

note: Crystal River valley 1.5 miles before Marble (Aspen-Sopris RD, White River NF); widely spaced sites, several at the river's edge, paved campground roads. Concession-run (American Land & Leisure). The group campground is 1/4 mile east. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $32 (recreation.gov 2026-27), no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov. Changed count 36 -> 35 (FS: 35 plus a host site) and max_rig_ft 80 -> 40 (FS: '40-foot maximum RV length'). Added pull-throughs, vault/composting toilets, faucet water, no dump, some FCFS, 2-day cutoff, 14-night limit, reservable season 05-13 to 10-01. No campground season statement (the FS dates link goes to a list without dates), so season left absent. No current alert on CR 3.
flags: Fee conflict: recreation.gov's 2026 and 2027 rate table says $32, the Forest Service page (last updated June 2025) says $34. Recorded $32.
Max length conflict: the Forest Service page states a 40-foot maximum RV length; the recreation.gov catalog lists sites to 80 ft. Recorded 40 (fine for EKKO either way).

Entry phone is empty. recreation.gov gives 970-927-0107 and, for the concessionaire American Land & Leisure, 801-226-3564; the FS page names only the Aspen-Sopris Ranger District (no number on the page; the Supervisor's Office is 970-945-2521).
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/bogan-flats-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
